comments.author: Montador
comments.body: The details of the quest is different depending on which city you get it from. So no guide. You just need Gunnery rank 1 to spawn the quest and you need to go sink a fleet somewhere (location different depending on which city you get the quest from). Of course, the details and general location will be told to you in the quest info itself.
